6. Each action of M09.actions accepted and changing its record — a Customer's

verdicts.why: The check exercises every listed audited action and uses the helper to require exactly one new entry, while fault injection shows that a Customer restriction and its entry roll back together. It does not establish transactional atomicity for every M09 action or the full reverse implication that no entry can exist except for an accepted changed action.
